The Dynamic San Marino DYN-6206-01 is a 2-person FAR infrared sauna built for anyone who wants a private, daily wellness ritual without giving up living space. Compact enough to fit in a basement, master bath, walk-in closet, or fitness room — yet spacious enough to share — the San Marino brings genuine therapeutic heat into your home in a beautifully crafted, easy-to-assemble package.

Step inside and feel the difference that FAR infrared carbon heating makes. Unlike conventional steam or dry saunas that simply heat the air around you, FAR infrared heats the body directly rather than heating the air around it. Sessions feel comfortable and breathable even as your body heats up, making it easy to stay in longer and build the kind of consistent routine that delivers real results over time.

The San Marino is equipped with 6 Dynamic Low EMF FAR infrared carbon heating panels — 2 on the rear wall, 1 on each side wall, 1 under the bench, and 1 on the floor — delivering full-body coverage including your legs and feet with every session. Low EMF output between 5–10 MG measured 2 to 3 inches from the heating panels keeps electromagnetic exposure minimal. The interior chromotherapy color lighting system with Red Light Therapy adds a therapeutic dimension to your session, with multiple color settings to shift your energy, calm your mind, or support skin wellness. Temperature can be set from 118°F up to a maximum of 140°F, with the 118°F–132°F range being the therapeutic sweet spot for most users.

Controls are simple and accessible from inside and out. The interior and exterior LED control panels let you set your temperature, timer, and lighting before you even step in — or adjust on the fly mid-session. The built-in Bluetooth and MP3 auxiliary connection with 2 dynamic speakers and pre-amp means your playlist, podcast, or meditation audio is always part of the experience. Clasp-together panel assembly means two people can have this unit fully set up without special tools, and the 120V/15 AMP plug-and-play electrical connection means no electrician or dedicated circuit is required — just a standard outlet on a dedicated breaker.

The cabin is constructed from natural reforested Canadian Hemlock wood — a dense, moisture-stable softwood that handles heat cycles well and ages gracefully. The clear tempered glass door and roof vent complete a design that feels open and well-ventilated rather than cramped. The unit is designated for indoor use only and ships in 2 boxes, making delivery and setup manageable.

Dynamic Saunas is a product line developed by Golden Designs, Inc., a California-based company dedicated to home infrared sauna wellness. The Dynamic line is engineered to bring authentic FAR infrared performance to everyday home use — with verified EMF ratings, responsibly sourced wood, and a plug-and-play approach that removes barriers to ownership. The San Marino has been one of the line's consistently popular 2-person models, valued for its balance of footprint, features, and accessible price point.
